# Rovax.io Documentation

> Rovax.io is an AI Agent platform for customer support, sales, and multichannel
> automation. You build Agents (identity, prompt, model, tools, knowledge), connect
> them to channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, Widget, Telegram, Slack), orchestrate them
> with Workflows and Squads, hand conversations to humans in the Inbox, and drive
> everything programmatically through a REST API.

Documentation: https://docs.rovax.io
Application:   https://app.rovax.io
API base URL:  https://api.rovax.io
Support:       contato@rovax.io

Languages: pt-BR is served at the root path (/...), English at /en/...
Product concepts are identical across both; this file lists both trees.

This file is generated from docs.json (navigation), the page front matter of every
MDX file, and api-reference/openapi.en.json (the OpenAPI 3 contract).
It has two parts:
  Part 1 — Documentation map: every published page, its description, and its sections.
  Part 2 — API reference: every endpoint with parameters, bodies, responses, and schemas.


===============================================================================
PART 1 — DOCUMENTATION MAP
===============================================================================

### Agentes

It is a configurable AI entity capable of reasoning, using tools, interacting with data, and collaborating with humans — all inside a single platform. Agents are designed to start simple (just a Role and a Prompt) and evolve progressively with Memory, Kn…
  - Sections: Core Identity; Settings That Shape Behavior; Extending Agent Capabilities; Acting Through Tools; Conditional Prompts; Where Agents Operate; Why Rovax Agents Are Different

- [Nó Variáveis (Definir Variável)](https://docs.rovax.io/guides/workflows/nodes/variables) — Crie, armazene e transforme valores para reutilizar em qualquer ponto do workflow via {{ $vars.nome }}.

## Welcome

### Agents

#### Creating an agent
- [Creating an Agent from Scratch](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/creating/from-scratch) — Step-by-step guide to manually creating an agent in Rovax.io: choosing the model, defining the name, role, prompt, and saving with full control from the start.
  - Sections: How to create; Next steps after creation
- [Creating with Orion AI](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/creating/wizard) — How to use Rovax.io's guided flow to create an agent via conversation: the assistant asks the right questions and generates the prompt automatically.
  - Sections: How it works; Why use the assistant?
- [Duplicating an Agent](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/duplicating) — Duplicate an Agent to reuse its configuration in the current Draft: what gets copied, which resources are shared, and how failures are handled.

#### Agent settings
- [Agent Settings](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/overview) — Summary of all configuration sections available for an agent in Rovax.io and what each one is for.
  - Sections: Summary
- [Model Selection](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/model) — How to choose the provider and LLM model for each agent in Rovax.io, capability comparison, credit cost, and selection best practices.
  - Sections: Where to select the model; How providers work; Switching model per agent; Best practices
- [Agent Internal Name](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/internal-name) — The internal name identifies the agent within the Rovax.io platform and appears in logs, reports, and selectors — never to the end customer.
- [Agent Role](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/role) — How the role defines the agent's function and persona in Rovax.io, influencing the framing the model uses to interpret ambiguities and make decisions.
  - Sections: Best practices; Example
- [System Prompt](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/prompt) — How to use Rovax.io's prompt editor: recommended structure, real-time quality analysis, automatic AI improvement, and version history.
- [Temperature](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/temperature) — How the temperature parameter affects the variability of agent responses, recommended ranges by use case, and how to configure the slider in Rovax.io.
- [Effort (Reasoning Level)](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/effort) — How the effort parameter controls the depth of the agent's reasoning in Rovax.io, its impact on cost and latency, and when to use each level.
- [Agent Capabilities](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/capacities) — Optional features you can enable per agent in Rovax.io: planning, reasoning, and automatic date and time.
  - Sections: Planning; Reasoning; Date and time; Best practices
- [Conditional Prompts](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/conditional-prompts) — How to use conditional prompts in Rovax.io to adapt agent behavior by customer segment, channel, or funnel stage without creating multiple agents.
  - Sections: What is a conditional prompt?; How conditional prompts work; Usage examples; Best practices
- [Internal Chat](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/agents/settings/internal-chat) — How to use Rovax.io's internal chat to test the agent directly on the platform, inspect executions, and validate behavior before publishing.
  - Sections: What you can do with the internal chat; Why the internal chat matters

#### Workflow nodes
- [Workflow Nodes](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/workflows/nodes/overview) — Index of all nodes available in the Rovax.io Workflows editor.
- [Webhook Node](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/workflows/nodes/webhook) — Receive external HTTP requests and use the payload as the entry point of your workflow in Rovax.io.
  - Sections: How It Works; Configuration Options; Authentication Options; Node Test Mode; Response Behavior; Common Use Cases; Best Practices; Summary
- [Agent Node (Agent Request)](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/workflows/nodes/agent) — Expose a workflow as a tool for Rovax.io AI agents.
  - Sections: How It Works; Configuration Options; Common Use Cases
- [HTTP Request Node](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/workflows/nodes/http) — Call any external REST API from within your workflow — GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE, with custom headers and automatic retry.
  - Sections: How It Works; Configuration Options; Common Use Cases
- [Variables Node (Set Variable)](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/workflows/nodes/variables) — Create, store, and transform values to reuse at any point in the workflow via {{ $vars.name }}.
  - Sections: How It Works; Configuration Options; Common Use Cases
- [LLM Node (AI Transformation)](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/workflows/nodes/llm) — Process text with a language model directly in the workflow — without an agent persona.
  - Sections: How It Works; Configuration Options; Common Use Cases; Example; Tip
- [JavaScript Code Node](https://docs.rovax.io/en/guides/workflows/nodes/javascript) — Run custom JavaScript in an isolated runtime to transform, validate, or combine data within the workflow.
  - Sections: What It Does; Input and Output; Configuration; Available APIs; Examples; Error Handling; Limits; Next Steps

===============================================================================
PART 2 — API REFERENCE
===============================================================================

API: Rovax.io API (version 1.0.0)
Server: https://api.rovax.io

Rovax.io REST API for AI-powered customer service automation. Manage agents, conversations, contacts, and integrations.

## Authentication

- Scheme `ApiKeyAuth`: type=apiKey in=header name=x-api-key
  API key obtained from the dashboard

Send the key on every request unless an endpoint is marked as public:
  x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
Keys are created at https://app.rovax.io/developers

## Conventions

- Resource IDs are UUIDs; timestamps are ISO 8601.
- List endpoints accept page, limit, order and return a pagination object
  (page, limit, total, total_pages). Default page=1, limit=20, max limit=100.
- Successful responses wrap the payload in a data key.
- Errors return an error object: { code, message, status }.
- Rate limit headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining,
  X-RateLimit-Reset, Retry-After.

## Reusable parameters

- Page (page): in=query, type=integer, default=1, min=1
  Page number
- Limit (limit): in=query, type=integer, default=20, min=1, max=100
  Items per page
- Order (order): in=query, type=string, default=desc, enum=asc|desc
  Sort direction
- Search (search): in=query, type=string
  Search term
- AgentId (id): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Agent ID
- TrainingId (id): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Training ID
- ChannelId (id): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Channel ID
- ContactId (id): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Contact ID
- ConversationId (id): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Conversation ID
- MessageId (messageId): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Message ID
- ChatId (id): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Chat ID
- CustomFieldId (id): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Custom field ID
- WebhookId (id): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  Webhook ID
- ToolId (toolId): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  MCP tool ID
- McpId (mcpId): in=path, type=string, format=uuid, required
  MCP server ID

## Endpoint index

Total: 72 operations across 11 groups.

System:
  GET    /v1/health                                           Health check
  GET    /v1/me                                               API key information

Agents:
  GET    /v1/agents                                           List agents
  POST   /v1/agents                                           Create agent
  DELETE /v1/agents/{id}                                      Delete agent
  GET    /v1/agents/{id}                                      Get agent
  PUT    /v1/agents/{id}                                      Update agent
  POST   /v1/agents/{id}/activate                             Activate agent
  GET    /v1/agents/{id}/behavior-history                     Behavior history
  POST   /v1/agents/{id}/context                              Inject context into agent
  POST   /v1/agents/{id}/conversation                         Create conversation with agent
  GET    /v1/agents/{id}/credits                              Get agent credits
  POST   /v1/agents/{id}/deactivate                           Deactivate agent
  GET    /v1/agents/{id}/settings                             Get agent settings
  PUT    /v1/agents/{id}/settings                             Update agent settings
  GET    /v1/agents/{id}/webhooks                             Get agent webhooks
  PUT    /v1/agents/{id}/webhooks                             Update agent webhooks

Trainings:
  GET    /v1/agents/{id}/trainings                            List agent trainings
  POST   /v1/agents/{id}/trainings                            Create training
  DELETE /v1/trainings/{id}                                   Delete training
  PUT    /v1/trainings/{id}                                   Update training

Channels:
  GET    /v1/channels                                         List channels
  POST   /v1/channels                                         Create channel
  DELETE /v1/channels/{id}                                    Delete channel
  PUT    /v1/channels/{id}                                    Update channel
  GET    /v1/channels/{id}/config                             Get channel configuration
  PUT    /v1/channels/{id}/config                             Update channel configuration
  POST   /v1/channels/{id}/conversation                       Start conversation on channel
  GET    /v1/channels/{id}/qr-code                            Get channel QR code
  GET    /v1/channels/{id}/widget/links                       Get widget links
  PUT    /v1/channels/{id}/widget/settings                    Update widget settings

Contacts:
  GET    /v1/contacts                                         List contacts
  POST   /v1/contacts                                         Create contact
  DELETE /v1/contacts/{id}                                    Delete contact
  GET    /v1/contacts/{id}                                    Get contact
  PUT    /v1/contacts/{id}                                    Update contact

Conversations:
  GET    /v1/conversations                                    List conversations
  DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}                               Close conversation
  GET    /v1/conversations/{id}                               Get conversation
  POST   /v1/conversations/{id}/ai-resume                     Resume AI agent
  POST   /v1/conversations/{id}/human-handoff                 Start human handoff
  DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}/messages                      Delete all messages
  GET    /v1/conversations/{id}/messages                      List conversation messages
  POST   /v1/conversations/{id}/messages                      Send message
  DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}/messages/{messageId}          Delete message
  PUT    /v1/conversations/{id}/messages/{messageId}          Edit message

Custom Fields:
  GET    /v1/custom-fields                                    List custom fields
  POST   /v1/custom-fields                                    Create custom field
  PUT    /v1/custom-fields/{id}                               Update custom field
  PUT    /v1/custom-fields/{id}/archive                       Archive custom field

Chats:
  DELETE /v1/chats/{id}                                       Delete chat
  DELETE /v1/chats/{id}/messages                              Delete chat messages
  DELETE /v1/chats/{id}/messages/{messageId}                  Delete chat message
  PUT    /v1/chats/{id}/messages/{messageId}                  Edit chat message
  POST   /v1/chats/{id}/start-human                           Start human support
  POST   /v1/chats/{id}/stop-human                            Stop human support

Messages:
  DELETE /v1/messages/{id}                                    Delete message
  GET    /v1/messages/{id}                                    Get message

MCP:
  POST   /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/add                               Add MCP server
  POST   /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/connect                           Connect MCP server
  POST   /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/sync-tools                        Sync MCP tools
  GET    /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/tools                             List MCP tools
  PUT    /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/tools/{toolId}/active             Activate MCP tool
  PUT    /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/tools/{toolId}/inactive           Deactivate MCP tool
  DELETE /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/{mcpId}                           Remove MCP server

Webhooks:
  GET    /v1/webhooks                                         List webhooks
  POST   /v1/webhooks                                         Create webhook
  DELETE /v1/webhooks/{id}                                    Delete webhook
  GET    /v1/webhooks/{id}                                    Get webhook
  PUT    /v1/webhooks/{id}                                    Update webhook
  GET    /v1/webhooks/{id}/deliveries                         List webhook deliveries
  POST   /v1/webhooks/{id}/test                               Test webhook


## Endpoints in detail


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### System
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Health check and API key introspection

GET /v1/health
  Summary: Health check
  Description: Checks whether the API is running. Does not require authentication.
  operationId: healthCheck
  Auth: none (public endpoint)
  Responses:
    - 200: API is running
        - status: string
        - timestamp: string (date-time)

GET /v1/me
  Summary: API key information
  Description: Returns information about the API key, including scopes and permissions.
  operationId: getApiKeyInfo
  Auth: x-api-key
  Responses:
    - 200: API key information
        - data: object
          - key_name: string
          - company_id: string (uuid)
          - workspace_id: string (uuid)
          - scopes: array<string>
          - permissions: object
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key

  Parameters:

  Auth: x-api-key

    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

POST /v1/chats/{id}/stop-human
  Summary: Stop human support
  Description: Resumes AI agent control.
  operationId: stopHumanChat
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - ChatId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: AI agent resumed
        - data: object
          - id: string (uuid)
          - ai_mode: string (enum: auto)
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Messages
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Individual messages

DELETE /v1/messages/{id}
  Summary: Delete message
  Description: Removes a message.
  operationId: deleteMessage
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - MessageId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: Message deleted
        DeleteResponse (see Schemas)
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

GET /v1/messages/{id}
  Summary: Get message
  Description: Returns details of a specific message.
  operationId: getMessage
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - MessageId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: Message details
        - data: Message
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### MCP
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Model Context Protocol — servers and tools

POST /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/add
  Summary: Add MCP server
  Description: Adds a new MCP server to the agent.
  operationId: addMcpServer
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - AgentId (reusable, see above)
  Request body (application/json) [required]:
    CreateMcpServer (see Schemas)
  Responses:
    - 201: MCP server added
        - data: McpServer
    - 400: Invalid request data
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

POST /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/connect
  Summary: Connect MCP server
  Description: Establishes a connection with an MCP server.
  operationId: connectMcpServer
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - AgentId (reusable, see above)
  Request body (application/json) [required]:
    - mcp_id: string (uuid) [required]
  Responses:
    - 200: MCP server connected
        - data: McpServer
    - 400: Invalid request data
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

POST /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/sync-tools
  Summary: Sync MCP tools
  Description: Syncs tools from all of the agent's MCP servers.
  operationId: syncMcpTools
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - AgentId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: Tools synced
        - data: object
          - synced: integer
          - tools: array<McpTool>
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

GET /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/tools
  Summary: List MCP tools
  Description: Lists tools available on the agent's MCP servers.
  operationId: listMcpTools
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - AgentId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: List of tools
        - data: array<McpTool>
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

PUT /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/tools/{toolId}/active
  Summary: Activate MCP tool
  Description: Activates an MCP tool for use by the agent.
  operationId: activateMcpTool
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - AgentId (reusable, see above)
    - ToolId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: Tool activated
        - data: McpTool
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

PUT /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/tools/{toolId}/inactive
  Summary: Deactivate MCP tool
  Description: Deactivates an MCP tool.
  operationId: deactivateMcpTool
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - AgentId (reusable, see above)
    - ToolId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: Tool deactivated
        - data: McpTool
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

DELETE /v1/agent/{id}/mcp/{mcpId}
  Summary: Remove MCP server
  Description: Removes an MCP server from the agent.
  operationId: deleteMcpServer
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - AgentId (reusable, see above)
    - McpId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: MCP server removed
        DeleteResponse (see Schemas)
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Webhooks
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Outbound webhooks for real-time events

GET /v1/webhooks
  Summary: List webhooks
  Description: Returns a list of configured webhooks.
  operationId: listWebhooks
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - Page (reusable, see above)
    - Limit (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: List of webhooks
        - data: array<Webhook>
        - pagination: Pagination
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key

POST /v1/webhooks
  Summary: Create webhook
  Description: Creates a new webhook to receive events.
  operationId: createWebhook
  Auth: x-api-key
  Request body (application/json) [required]:
    CreateWebhook (see Schemas)
  Responses:
    - 201: Webhook created
        - data: Webhook
    - 400: Invalid request data
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key

DELETE /v1/webhooks/{id}
  Summary: Delete webhook
  Description: Removes a webhook.
  operationId: deleteWebhook
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - WebhookId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: Webhook deleted
        DeleteResponse (see Schemas)
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

GET /v1/webhooks/{id}
  Summary: Get webhook
  Description: Returns details of a webhook.
  operationId: getWebhook
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - WebhookId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: Webhook details
        - data: Webhook
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

PUT /v1/webhooks/{id}
  Summary: Update webhook
  Description: Updates an existing webhook.
  operationId: updateWebhook
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - WebhookId (reusable, see above)
  Request body (application/json) [required]:
    UpdateWebhook (see Schemas)
  Responses:
    - 200: Webhook updated
        - data: Webhook
    - 400: Invalid request data
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

GET /v1/webhooks/{id}/deliveries
  Summary: List webhook deliveries
  Description: Returns the delivery history for a webhook.
  operationId: listWebhookDeliveries
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - WebhookId (reusable, see above)
    - Page (reusable, see above)
    - Limit (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: List of deliveries
        - data: array<WebhookDelivery>
        - pagination: Pagination
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found

POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/test
  Summary: Test webhook
  Description: Sends a test event to the webhook.
  operationId: testWebhook
  Auth: x-api-key
  Parameters:
    - WebhookId (reusable, see above)
  Responses:
    - 200: Test sent
        - data: object
          - success: boolean
          - status_code: integer
          - response_time_ms: integer
    - 401: Invalid or missing API key
    - 404: Resource not found


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Schemas
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Agent
  - id: string (uuid)
  - name: string
  - description: string
  - avatar_url: string (uri)
  - status: string (enum: active|inactive)
  - model: string
  - temperature: number
  - created_at: string (date-time)
  - updated_at: string (date-time)

AgentSettings
  - max_tokens: integer
  - context_window: integer
  - system_prompt: string
  - fallback_message: string
  - typing_delay_ms: integer

AgentWebhooks
  - on_message: string (uri)
  - on_conversation_start: string (uri)
  - on_conversation_end: string (uri)

BehaviorHistory
  - id: string (uuid)
  - field: string
  - old_value: string
  - new_value: string
  - changed_by: string (uuid)
  - created_at: string (date-time)

Channel
  - id: string (uuid)
  - name: string
  - type: string (enum: whatsapp|telegram|email|website|instagram)
  - status: string (enum: active|inactive|pending)
  - agent_id: string (uuid)
  - created_at: string (date-time)

ChannelConfig
  - phone_number: string
  - api_key: string
  - webhook_url: string (uri)

Contact
  - id: string (uuid)
  - customer_name: string
  - customer_email: string (email)
  - customer_phone: string
  - status: string (enum: active|inactive|blocked)
  - tags: array<string>
  - custom_fields: object
  - created_at: string (date-time)
  - updated_at: string (date-time)

Conversation
  - id: string (uuid)
  - channel: string
  - channel_id: string (uuid)
  - contact_id: string (uuid)
  - agent_id: string (uuid)
  - customer_name: string
  - status: string (enum: open|closed|pending)
  - ai_mode: string (enum: auto|paused)
  - last_message_at: string (date-time)
  - created_at: string (date-time)

CreateAgent
  - name: string [required]
  - description: string
  - avatar_url: string (uri)
  - model: string
  - temperature: number

CreateChannel
  - name: string [required]
  - type: string (enum: whatsapp|telegram|email|website|instagram) [required]
  - agent_id: string (uuid) [required]

CreateContact
  - customer_name: string [required]
  - customer_email: string (email)
  - customer_phone: string
  - tags: array<string>
  - custom_fields: object

CreateCustomField
  - name: string [required]
  - type: string (enum: text|number|date|boolean|select|multiselect) [required]
  - description: string
  - options: array<string>
  - required: boolean

CreateMcpServer
  - name: string [required]
  - url: string (uri) [required]
  - api_key: string

CreateMessage
  - content: string [required]
  - sender_type: string (enum: customer|agent|ai|system|bot)
  - message_type: string (enum: text|image|file|audio|video)
  - media_url: string (uri)
  - media_type: string

CreateTraining
  - title: string [required]
  - content: string [required]
  - type: string (enum: text|file|url)

CreateWebhook
  - name: string [required]
  - url: string (uri) [required]
  - events: array<string (enum: conversation.created|conversation.closed|conversation.transferred|message.received|message.sent|contact.created|contact.updated|appointment.created|appointment.cancelled|appointment.completed)> [required]

CustomField
  - id: string (uuid)
  - name: string
  - type: string (enum: text|number|date|boolean|select|multiselect)
  - description: string
  - options: array<string>
  - required: boolean
  - archived: boolean
  - created_at: string (date-time)

DeleteResponse
  - data: object
    - deleted: boolean

Error
  - error: object
    - code: string
    - message: string
    - status: integer

McpServer
  - id: string (uuid)
  - name: string
  - url: string (uri)
  - status: string (enum: connected|disconnected|error)
  - tools_count: integer
  - created_at: string (date-time)

McpTool
  - id: string (uuid)
  - mcp_server_id: string (uuid)
  - name: string
  - description: string
  - input_schema: object
  - is_active: boolean

Message
  - id: string (uuid)
  - conversation_id: string (uuid)
  - content: string
  - sender_type: string (enum: customer|agent|ai|system|bot)
  - message_type: string (enum: text|image|file|audio|video|contact|transfer)
  - media_url: string (uri)
  - media_type: string
  - is_edited: boolean
  - created_at: string (date-time)

Pagination
  - page: integer
  - limit: integer
  - total: integer
  - total_pages: integer

Training
  - id: string (uuid)
  - agent_id: string (uuid)
  - title: string
  - content: string
  - type: string (enum: text|file|url)
  - status: string (enum: pending|processed|failed)
  - created_at: string (date-time)

UpdateAgent
  - name: string
  - description: string
  - avatar_url: string (uri)
  - model: string
  - temperature: number

UpdateChannel
  - name: string
  - agent_id: string (uuid)

UpdateContact
  - customer_name: string
  - customer_email: string (email)
  - customer_phone: string
  - status: string (enum: active|inactive|blocked)
  - tags: array<string>
  - custom_fields: object

UpdateCustomField
  - name: string
  - description: string
  - options: array<string>
  - required: boolean

UpdateTraining
  - title: string
  - content: string

UpdateWebhook
  - name: string
  - url: string (uri)
  - events: array<string (enum: conversation.created|conversation.closed|conversation.transferred|message.received|message.sent|contact.created|contact.updated|appointment.created|appointment.cancelled|appointment.completed)>
  - is_active: boolean

Webhook
  - id: string (uuid)
  - name: string
  - url: string (uri)
  - events: array<string>
  - is_active: boolean
  - secret: string — Returned only at creation
  - created_at: string (date-time)

WebhookDelivery
  - id: string (uuid)
  - webhook_id: string (uuid)
  - event: string
  - status: string (enum: pending|success|failed)
  - status_code: integer
  - response_time_ms: integer
  - attempt: integer
  - next_retry_at: string (date-time)
  - created_at: string (date-time)

WidgetSettings
  - primary_color: string
  - position: string (enum: bottom-right|bottom-left)
  - welcome_message: string
  - placeholder: string
